div.p: This provides a list of changes to the NHSN Measures IG

li.b: Update Implementation Guide Dependencies (US Core and Measure Related IGs): [MEASDEV-1805]

ul.li:
Updated the following IG dependencies:
Updated US Core IG dependency from US Core 3.1.1 to US Core 6.1.0
Added a dependency to the NHSN Digital Quality Measure (dQM) Reporting Implementation Guide used for reporting artifacts including MeasureReport, Patients of Interest List, and other reporting framework artifacts.
Updated quality Measures IG dependency from CQF Measures 3.0.0 to CQF Measures 5.0.0. This includes several Measure related artifact extensions changing from CQFM to CRMI StructureDefinitions.
Added a dependency to the Canonical Resource Management Infrastructure Implementation Guide used for ValueSet definition and Measure extensions. This includes several Measure related artifact extensions changing from CQFM to CRMI StructureDefinitions.
Updated Data Exchange For Quality Measures (DeQM) IG dependency from DeQM 3.1.0 to DeQM 5.0.0
Updated Quality Improvement (QI) Core IG dependency from QI Core 4.1.1 to QI Core 6.0.0

This affected the following definitional artifacts:
Update Cross-Measure Patient Profile from US Core 3.1.1 US Core Patient to QI Core 6.1 Patient, which is based on US Core 6.1 Patient Profile
Updated the NHSN Individual MeasureReport List from the FHIR standard base List resource to the DEQM Individual MeasureReport Profile
Updated the Subject-List MeasureReport Profile from the FHIR standard base MeasureReport resource to the DEQM Subject List MeasureReport
Updated the NHSN MeasureReport Bundle from the FHIR standard base Bundle resource to the HL7 NHSN MeasureReport Bundle Profile
Removed the Submitting Organization Profile and using the HL7 NHSN dQM Submitting Profile
Removed the Patients of Interest Profile and using the HL7 NHSN dQM Patients-Of-Interest List
Removed the SubmittingDevice Profile and using the HL7 NHSN dQM Submitting Device
US Core 6.1 updates for Acute Care Hospital Monthly Profiles:
Apply both US Core 6.1 Condition Profile constraints into a single ACH Monthly Event Condition Profile

ACH Monthly Event Diagnostic Report (Lab)
